questions.question: What is the plan called when six people take Polyjuice Potion to look like Harry?
questions.note: They fly him off Privet Drive before the protective charm breaks on his seventeenth birthday. Harry rides with Hagrid.

questions.question: What is the name of Harry's owl, who is killed during that escape?
questions.note: In the film she is loose in the air and takes a curse meant for the chase. Hagrid gave her to Harry for his eleventh birthday.

questions.question: Which Order member is killed during the flight from Privet Drive?
questions.note: Mundungus panics and Disapparates, leaving Moody alone against Voldemort. George's ear is cursed off in the same chase.

questions.question: Whose wedding is broken up when the Ministry falls?
questions.note: A Patronus arrives in the middle of the reception: the Ministry has fallen. Death Eaters attack the Burrow.

questions.question: What words are written on the Snitch Dumbledore leaves Harry?
choices: I solemnly swear that I am up to no good
The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death
questions.note: The writing shows when Harry puts the Snitch to his mouth. It opens in the forest, when he is ready to die.

questions.question: Who is wearing Slytherin's locket when Harry, Ron, and Hermione find it?
questions.note: They Polyjuice into Ministry workers to steal it. The new statue in the Atrium reads 'Magic is Might.'

questions.question: Who destroys Slytherin's locket?
questions.note: He comes back after walking out on the hunt. The locket shows him Harry and Hermione kissing. He strikes it with the Sword of Gryffindor.

questions.question: What book does Dumbledore leave Hermione in his will?
questions.answer: The Tales of Beedle the Bard
choices: The Tales of Beedle the Bard
Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
questions.note: Ron gets the Deluminator, which puts lights out and later leads him back to his friends. Harry gets the Snitch.

questions.question: The Elder Wand, the Resurrection Stone, and the Invisibility Cloak are known together as what?
questions.note: The Tale of the Three Brothers, in Beedle the Bard, is the story of how they were made. Harry already owns the cloak.

questions.question: Who Apparates the prisoners out of Malfoy Manor and is killed for it?
questions.note: Bellatrix throws a knife as they vanish. He dies at Shell Cottage, in Bill and Fleur's garden.
